text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: P2 inference-proxy.latency-us-west2 — rate of 99th pct token latency > SLO for 2m. PD incident: INC-83721. Auto-note: runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-latency
ops-bot: Routing: canary-replay traffic spike detected on us-west2 canary pool (metric spike).
alex: ack
alex: looking at console now — 99p jumped from ~450ms -> 1.2s at 12:03 UTC, short spike, CPU on proxies normal, GPU qps steady
sam: oncall: any deploys around that time?
alex: nothing in release feed, only synthetic-corpus canary at +small bump (10qps)
mira: checking support dashboard — error rate flat, a couple slow requests surfaced but no 500s, frontend retries increased slightly
sam: could be prefilling / kv warmup churn on some pods? we hit a coldset earlier this morning for evicted KV shards
alex: possible. I see a small number of KV cache misses correlating to the latency window (trace IDs listed in trace UI).
ops-bot: PD: 3x page attempts, escalation to eng-oncall.
alex: adding quick mitigation: disable canary replay for us-west2 for next 10m :gear:
mira: noted, I'll post to status if this sustains >10m. For now looks transient.
sam: I'll monitor autoscaler logs and prefill jobs, watching for repeat 1m spikes
ops-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved at 12:06 UTC (no active incidents).
alex: confirming auto-resolve. I left canary off and warmed a couple KV buckets manually.
mira: good catch. marking customer-impact: none. adding to post-incident notes: transient canary replay + KV cold misses, consider raising canary throttle and prefill cadence.
alex: I'll follow up with infra team tomorrow to tune prefill and suppression rules.
sam: recommend adding a brief autopage suppression rule for <2m single-point lat spikes from synthetic traffic to reduce noise.
mira: +1 on suppression rule, and add a small dashboard alert to show KV-miss correlation.
alex: leaving a 15m watch on the thread then handing off to next oncall if nothing else. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: handover note created for next oncall.
alex: final — closing watch, no escalation required. thanks folks :pray:
